items.raw_excerpt: Discover how Peace by the Gram, a small-town cannabis store in Matheson, Ontario, achieved $1M in sales through community connections and keeping overhead low.
items.summary_en: Peace by the Gram, a cannabis store in Matheson, Ontario, reached $1 million in sales. The store focused on low overhead and building relationships with local residents. Their success shows how small-town businesses can thrive by listening to their community.

items.raw_excerpt: Exhibition station on the doorstep of Toronto's Liberty Village is in the midst of an unprecedented transformation, as work continues to turn the once-modest rail stop into a major interchange. Set to host the western terminus of Ontario Line 3 alongside electrified, more-frequent service on GO Transit's Lakeshore West Line, Exhibition station will serve as a downtown
items.summary_en: Toronto's Exhibition Station in Liberty Village is being rebuilt into a major transit interchange. The project adds Ontario Line 3's western terminus alongside upgraded GO Transit Lakeshore West service. Two tunnel boring machines began digging under downtown in April 2026.

items.raw_excerpt: Mexico City has been dealing with a water crisis for nearly 400 years. Our expert traces the problems, and some potential solutions.
items.summary_en: Mexico City has struggled with water shortages for nearly four centuries. Experts point to aging infrastructure, overuse of groundwater, and climate change as key causes. New plans aim to improve how the city collects, stores, and distributes water.

items.title_en: Mexico City Looks to Solve Its 400-Year Water Problem
items.title_ko: 멕시코시티, 400년 된 물 문제 해결 모색
items.title_original: How Mexico City can solve its 400-year water crisis
